messages:
sam: Seeing a lot of onboarding retries. Users submit bad metadata, backend returns 400, SDK exposes a generic BadRequest so sampleapp retries and hits rate limits.

olivia: can you paste an example response?

sam: Example body we get: `{ "error": { "kind": "parse_error", "message": "metadata: expected object" } }` but some infra responses omit kind and just return plain text.

henry: root cause is SDK collapse of 4xx -> BadRequest. Plan: map server `error.kind` (when present) to typed exceptions (ParseError, ValidationError, AuthError, RateLimitError). Each error object should include `code` (stable id), `retriable` (boolean), optional `help_url`, and surface `request_id`/`error_id` when available.

omit: small nit: prefer `code` + `kind` together; code is machine stable (ERR_PARSE_METADATA) while kind is class-like.

olivia: SDK fallback when `error.kind` missing: heuristics only (Retry-After header -> RateLimitError, message contains 'token' -> AuthError, message contains 'expected'/'invalid' -> Parse/Validation). Document the heuristics.

mira: sampleapp change is straightforward: replace blanket retry with `if (err.retriable) retryWithBackoff()` and show `help_url` + `code` in UI with short copy and a support token.

henry: add unit tests asserting mapping for present/absent `kind`, plus an e2e where malformed metadata should not cause multiple client retries. Update CI fixtures.

error-bot: Created ticket DX-5100 (standardize error payload) and DX-5101 (SDK typed error mapping).

sam: owners: olivia -> TS/JS SDK, henry -> Go SDK, mira -> sampleapp + docs. Target quick patch this week to reduce support noise.

olivia: i'll open the TS PR and include migration guidance: please rely on `err.code` and `err.retriable` not message regex.

mira: i'll update sampleapp README and add a short FAQ entry about common parsing errors.

henry: will add a toLogEntry helper on the Go SDK so apps can log `{request_id, error_id, code, retriable}` consistently.

sam: great. small surface change but should cut onboarding tickets significantly. :tada:
